home.title: Atlas Agents
home.platformDescriptor: AI tenant framework for industry workspaces
home.headline: One agent platform. Many industry tenants.
home.support: Atlas Agents is a multi-tenant AI framework — each organization gets an isolated workspace with its own agents, tools, and desks. Sign in to open your tenant, whether that is Stockbroker trading ops, Dental clinic workflows, or another industry pack.
home.onboardingSupport: Provision your organization tenant, then publish workflows your teammates can run.
home.tenantStockbrokerHint: Trading desk, Signal Engine, Kite tools, and ops teams for market workflows.
home.tenantDentalHint: Clinic intake, scheduling assistants, and patient-facing agent surfaces.
home.tenantMoreHint: Spin up a new tenant pack — shared auth, sandbox tools, approvals, and traces.
home.twoDoorsTitle: Operate the tenant fabric, or work inside an industry workspace.
home.controlPlaneBody: Admins configure the AI tenant framework — agents, teams, knowledge, tools, and approvals — then publish experiences per organization.
home.controlPlaneBullet1: Draft, version, and publish agents & workflows per tenant
home.controlPlaneBullet2: Attach knowledge, credentials, and sandbox tools (Kite, clinic systems, and more)
home.controlPlaneBullet3: Trace runs, resolve approvals, manage org access
home.workspacePortalBody: Teammates sign in to their tenant-branded portal — Stockbroker desk, Dental workspace, or another pack — and run only assigned workflows and teams.
home.workspacePortalBullet1: Tenant-scoped surfaces for your org account
home.workspacePortalBullet2: Streaming chat with pause, cancel, and resume
home.pathTitle: A straight path into the right tenant surface.
home.step1Copy: Sign in with your organization account. Atlas resolves your tenant and role.
home.step2Copy: Open the workspace portal for your industry pack, or Admin when you need the control plane.
home.step3Copy: Start a workflow, team chat, or desk surface — streaming responses with human approvals when needed.
home.previewPrompt: What would you like to work on?
home.previewSubtext: Assigned desks, workflows, and teams for your tenant.
